description: Multi-panel file manager with tabs, built-in viewers, search, file comparison, and remote access.
notes: This Scoop package supports Windows 11 x64 and uses the self-contained portable build, without the installed administrator helper. Settings are kept in Scoop's persisted Data directory.
pre_install: if ([System.Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Build -lt 22000) { throw 'FileCat requires Windows build 22000 or newer.' }
